summary: Frontend-only verification of Prompt 10 Lot 5 partial (sound preview + Confort visuel toggles + canine status icons + Ken Burns class). All acceptance criteria met on Particulier account (membre1.demo@lavoixduchien.fr).
critical_code_review_comments: DogStatusBadge reads localStorage at render, so toggling requires a full page reload to reflect on already-mounted dog cards — this matches the spec and reload flow works. Could be improved by listening to a storage/custom event similar to sound.js's 'vdc-sound-changed'.
CoverBanner also reads localStorage at mount only; same reload-required pattern. Consider dispatching a shared 'vdc-prefs-changed' event from AccountSettings toggles for live update without reload.
test_credentials: Particulier: membre1.demo@lavoixduchien.fr / Demo2026! (used). Bureau not tested to avoid lockout — Particulier fully exercises the feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via /my-space -> COMPTE tab: account-sound-card/-switch/-preview present; account-visual-card with dogicons + kenburns switches persist to localStorage (vdc_dog_icons, vdc_kenburns). Sound preview button fires chime('badge', true) without JS errors. /dogs shows 12 dog cards, each with dog-status-<id>; when vdc_dog_icons='off' after reload -> 6 -dot elements 0 -icon elements; when re-enabled -> 6 -icon elements, 0 dot; status text 'Actif' always visible. No cover photo configured (no cover-banner on dashboard/dogs) — verified toggle still persists without errors; that path is spec-compliant. Console 401/403 errors are pre-existing (member calling admin-only endpoints) unrelated to this lot.
